newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss francs closed mixed with pressure on short-term bonds from continued worries that the United States or Germany may raise interest rates, traders said.
Conf federal futures and longer bonds were helped by gains by U.S. long bonds and German Bunds on U.S. data that showed consumer prices rose only moderately in July.
Turnover was low and customer orders were lacking, traders said.
Two-year Swiss ffranc swaps were up two basis points at 2.13/23 percent. Five-year and ten-year swaps were unchanged at 2.94/3.04 and 3.84/94 percent, respectively.
Conf futures up 22 basis points at 120.07 pct
